response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals FROM rental WHERE CAST(return_date AS TEXT) > '2005-07-13 08:35:51' AND CAST(return_date AS TEXT) < '2005-08-09 05:58:16'

assumptions.assumption: The sum of per-customer counts equals the total number of qualifying rentals, so I count rows directly. Rentals with a NULL return_date are excluded because they cannot satisfy the comparison.
return_date is stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text, so comparing it as text matches chronological order. Both endpoints are excluded, as stated.
